answer: Resist Sybil attacks with reputation maturation: a new identity starts with zero influence, and weight accrues only through sustained honest work across many epochs — the kernel of trust must be earned, not claimed. A violet flag in the open record marks fresh accounts, while a copper trail of past attestations proves real contribution. An attacker spawning thousands of fakes gains nothing on day one: each fake must behave honestly for weeks to earn weight, so the time and compute cost per identity multiplies until forgery costs more than joining honestly.
